import html # Example profile format template with placeholders. PROFILE_FORMAT = """

{full_name}

{about_me}

Status: {status_update}
""" def generate_user_profile(full_name: str, about_me: str, status_update: str) -> str: """ Construct a sanitized user profile HTML snippet. Parameters ---------- full_name : str The user's self-provided name. about_me : str A user-authored biography that may contain multiple sentences. status_update : str A short, current status update submitted by the user. Returns ------- str An HTML string ready for safe web display. All user-supplied content is escaped to prevent XSS (CWE‑79). """ # Escape all user-supplied data to neutralize potential XSS payloads. safe_full_name = html.escape(full_name, quote=True) safe_about_me = html.escape(about_me, quote=True) safe_status_update = html.escape(status_update, quote=True) # Populate the template with sanitized values. profile_html = PROFILE_FORMAT.format( full_name=safe_full_name, about_me=safe_about_me, status_update=safe_status_update ) return profile_html.strip()
